s.t:
Adfinis ist ein international tätiges IT-Dienstleistungsunternehmen mit Hauptsitz in der Schweiz, das derzeit weltweit rund 150 Mitarbeitende beschäftigt. Als Open-Source-Spezialisten treiben wir seit über 25 Jahren die digitale Transformation durch offene Standards und Technologien voran und gestalten eine Welt innovativer, nachhaltiger und resilienter IT-Lösungen, die auf zuverlässiger Open-Source-Technologie basieren.
Unser deutsches Team, bestehend aus rund 15 Personen, arbeitet eng mit Kunden zusammen, um sie auf ihrem organisatorischen und technischen Weg in die Cloud-Native-Welt zu unterstützen. Wir konzipieren, bauen und betreiben kritische IT-Infrastrukturen unter Verwendung moderner Cloud-Native-Technologien.
Aufgaben
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen Professional System Engineer . In dieser Rolle setzt du eigenständig Kundenprojekte zu Cluster, Container-, Automatisierungs- und CI/CD-Lösungen um.
ㅤ
💻 Deine Aufgaben

Cloud-Services nach bestehenden Architektur-Richtlinien designen
Cloud-Plattformen warten
Features, Services und Prozeduren sauber dokumentieren
dich direkt mit Kunden abstimmen und austauschen
technische Probleme analysieren und deren Ursachen beseitigen
Junior Engineers und neue Teammitglieder fachlich unterstützen
Qualifikation
🥋 Deine Expertise
Netzwerkdienste mit Firewalls und Load-Balancern konfigurieren
Workloads durch standardmässige Hardening-Verfahren effektiv schützen
Microservices debuggen und neustarttolerante Setups designen
automatisierte CI/CD-Workflows für effiziente Deployments erstellen
Tech-Themen souverän auf Deutsch und Englisch präsentieren
ㅤ
🪪 Dein Profil
2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung als System Engineer im Cloud-Umfeld
gute Anwendungskenntnisse in Container & Cloud (Kubernetes, EKS, AKS, OpenShift, SUSE Rancher, Helm, Argo CD), Automation & IaC (Terraform / OpenTofu, Ansible), Security (Vault / OpenBao, DevSecOps) und CI/CD & GitOps (GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Argo CD).
Deutsch- und Englisch-Kenntnisse auf C1-Niveau
ㅤ
🪄 Deine Soft-Skills
Herausforderungen anpacken und lösungsorientiert denken
Probleme durchdringen und tragfähige Lösungen umsetzen
Zuständigkeiten klären, Hürden ansprechen und Zusagen verlässlich einhalten
Prioritäten clever setzen, konsequent umsetzen und flexibel anpassen.

🦦 Unser Profil
Wir meinen es ECHT ernst mit Open Source. Alles transparent und zugänglich zu halten, die Zusammenarbeit zu fördern und die Community zu pushen – das ist nicht einfach nur das, was wir tun; das ist, wer wir sind.
Emacs, Nano oder Vim? Arch, Fedora oder NixOS? Welche Tools oder Distros auch immer dafür sorgen, dass du die beste Performance ablieferst – es liegt ganz bei dir. Ausser halt Microsoft-Produkte.
Wir sind bodenständig, setzen auf solide Prozesse und treffen schnelle Entscheidungen.
Growth Mindset wird bei uns gross geschrieben. Egal ob du deine Skills aufs nächste Level bringen willst, dir neue Zertifikate schnappst oder auf Konferenzen Erfahrungen sammelst – wir unterstützen dich dabei.
Klingt spannend?
Michael Moser , Country Manager Germany, freut sich auf deine Bewerbung.

Job Title: CSfC Systems EngineerJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: SecretEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Local* * * The Opportunity: CACI is seeking a highly skilled and experienced CSfC Systems Engineer to provide expert-level technical design support for Archon's Commercial Solutions for Classified (CSfC) program customers across all portfolios.

As a technology leader, you will be working hands-on with a world-class engineering team to develop innovative solutions that enable advanced computing and communications functions.

In this role, you will be responsible for designing and implementing secure, high-performance systems and network architectures that meet the stringent security requirements of classified systems.

You will leverage your deep knowledge of CSfC principles, protocols, and technologies to develop solutions that are both effective and compliant with government regulations. Responsibilities:
Design and configure complex system and network architectures that meet the specific requirements of warfighter operations, including the integration of solutions that support the underlying architecture such as Hypervisors, certificate issuance and verification suites, name resolution, load balancing, other management required operating systems like Windows server and RedHat Linux.
Serves as the highest tier escalation point for the most advanced troubleshooting and diagnostics of CSfC solutions, including the identification and resolution of complex issues related to network performance, security, and compliance
Conducts thorough root cause analysis to identify the underlying causes of system issues and recommends effective mitigation strategies
Perform high-level systems analysis, evaluation, integration, and implementation of complex system solutions. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining highly secure, high-performance system architectures that meet the specific mission requirements of the organization.
Provide expert-level engineering guidance in the implementation of system specifications, design, integration, testing, and documentation. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring that the system meets its functional, performance, and security requirements while adhering to industry best practices and government regulations for highly secure data transport.
Leverage automation technologies, such as Ansible, to create repeatable and idempotent tasks for engineering work committed.
Utilize existing DevSecOps pipelines for publishing work and able to contribute to merge requests and peer reviews in a common baseline.
Author, manage and maintain written technical materials.
Provide subject matter expertise and interact regularly with the Design and Architecture team.

Secret or higher U.S. Government Security Clearance Required
At least 8 years of overall IT experience with a minimum of 4 years of experience in designing and operating complex Information Technology systems.
At least 3 years Server Operating Systems and Domain Administration experience in a Windows Server or later environment
At least 3 years Server Operating Systems and Domain Administration experience in a Red Hat Linux environment
At least 2 years virtualization experience in a VMware environment
At least 3 years networking experience in a Cisco environment
Astute observer with effective root cause identification and problem-solving skills
Exceptional communication skills – both written and verbal

This role is remote based. There is an expectation that you will travel regularly across the UK and Ireland to meet customers and partners in person, including on-site visits to government, defence, and defence industrial base locations as required.

Partner closely with Account Executives on public sector and defence opportunities, joining discovery conversations, territory planning, shaping solution direction, and helping move deals forward through the funnel.
Act as a senior technical lead within a pool of SEs supporting the Public Sector, Defence and Defence Industrial Base business, providing mentorship and technical direction to less experienced colleagues.
Translate customer requirements, including those with specific government and defence security, accreditation, and compliance considerations, into clear technical architectures, proposals, sizing, quotes, and solution concepts that build confidence and accelerate decision making.
Run technical presentations, demos, workshops, and follow-up sessions for government departments, defence customers, and defence industrial base primes and SMEs, both remotely and on-site across the UK and Ireland.
Enable and coach channel partner SEs through workshops, bootcamps, and joint customer engagement so partners can better position and scale solutions across the public sector and defence market.
Validate technical fit for opportunities, including storage architecture, protocols, virtualisation environments, and broader infrastructure considerations, with attention to the security and resilience requirements common in government and defence environments.
Collaborate across Systems Engineering, Sales, Partners, Support, Product, and other internal teams to solve customer challenges and deliver a strong buying experience for public sector and defence stakeholders.
Participate in internal training, pipeline reviews, technical enablement, and ongoing knowledge sharing across the team, including sharing domain expertise on public sector and defence procurement and requirements.

10+ years of relevant experience in pre-sales, systems engineering, solution architecture, or a similar customer facing technical role in the technology industry, ideally including experience with public sector, defence, or defence industrial base customers.
Strong grounding in storage and infrastructure fundamentals; storage experience is strongly preferred, and post-sales experience can also be relevant if paired with customer facing commercial capability.
Good understanding of block, file, and object storage, along with related technologies such as FC, iSCSI, NAS, SAN, virtualisation, and VMware-style environments.
Familiarity with UK government and defence procurement frameworks (such as G-Cloud and Crown Commercial Service frameworks), security classifications, and accreditation processes is highly valuable.
Ability to lead consultative technical discovery and engage confidently with senior customers, prospects, and partners across government, defence, and industry in both business and technical conversations.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas clearly and credibly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior government and defence stakeholders.
A collaborative, curious, and proactive working style, with a willingness to learn quickly, excellent technical discovery and qualification skills, and the confidence to ask questions when needed.
Experience working with or through channel partners and defence industrial base primes and SMEs is highly valuable, as partner enablement is a significant part of the role.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining strong attention to detail and follow-through.
Completed enhanced UK Government security vetting required.

Professional registration or licensure - Current registration as an Engineer Intern (EI), Engineer in Training (EIT), or licensure as a Professional Engineer (PE) by any State, the District of Columbia, Guam, or Puerto Rico.

Absent other means of qualifying under this standard, those applicants who achieved such registration by means other than written test (e.g., State grandfather or eminence provisions) are eligible only for positions that are within or closely related to the specialty field of their registration.

For example, an applicant who attains registration through a State Board's eminence provision as a manufacturing engineer typically would be rated eligible only for manufacturing engineering positions. 2.

Written Test - Evidence of having successfully passed the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) examination, or any other written test required for professional registration, by an engineering licensure board in the various States, the District of Columbia, Guam, or Puerto Rico. 3.

Specified academic courses - Successful completion of at least 60 semester hours of courses in the physical, mathematical, and engineering sciences and that included the courses specified in A above. The courses must be fully acceptable toward meeting the requirements of an engineering program. 4.

Related curriculum - Successful completion of a curriculum leading to a bachelor's degree in an appropriate scientific field, e.g., engineering technology, physics, chemistry, architecture, computer science, mathematics, hydrology, or geology, may be accepted in lieu of a degree in engineering, provided the applicant has had at least 1 year of professional engineering experience acquired under professional engineering supervision and guidance.

SkyGrid , a Wisk Company, exists to open the sky for autonomous flight. Based in Austin, Texas, SkyGrid builds ground-based high-assurance third-party services to enable the safe operations and airspace integration of highly automated and autonomous aircraft. The SkyGrid team is looking for a Senior Systems Engineer (Surveillance) to lead and support surveillance system activities across the company portfolio.

In this role, you will play a critical part in defining, architecting, and integrating SkyGrid ’s ground-based surveillance architectures across the Systems Engineering “V”, including the development of requirements, use cases, and functional architectures for technologies such as Detect and Avoid (DAA), ADS-B, Radar, and Traffic Collision Avoidance Systems (TCAS/ACAS).
This role directly supports certification, safety, and verification & validation (V&V) planning while utilizing a Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) paradigm throughout the system lifecycle.

Deliver high-quality systems lifecycle artifacts and technical leadership through the current CDR phase of the program and ensure on-time completion to support CDR review in the next 18-24 months.

Support the development of the System/Subsystem Design Description documents in relation to the Critical Design Reviews.
Identify and mitigate technical and performance risks covering traffic surveillance aspects of the system.

Capture, derive, and manage system and subsystem requirements for traffic surveillance based on operational needs, customer inputs, airspace constraints, and regulatory standards (e.g., FAA, EASA, applicable RTCA MOPS).
Develop and maintain SysML models (Use Case, Activity, Sequence, State machine, etc.) using MBSE methodologies and tools like Cameo.
Support the system architecture definition and technical integration for surveillance sensors and systems (e.g., ADS-B In/Out, Radar, DAA/ACAS, and transponders).
Advance and support system development activities including the current design phase through implementation, verification and validation, all the way through certification.
Support compliance with ARP4754B development practices and collaborate on system safety assessments per ARP4761A (FHA, PASA, SSA).
Support technical program reviews for SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, and qualification reviews.
Ensure compliance with customer, contractual, and regulatory requirements.
Coordinate cross-functional activities across engineering teams and review/supervise the technical work of junior and mid-level systems engineers.

7+ years of experience working in a highly technical, aerospace-related industry.
5+ years of experience working in a Systems Engineering position.
Hands-on experience with surveillance avionics systems, collision avoidance, or sensor fusion technologies (e.g., ADS-B, Radar, TCAS / ACAS X, DAA, Mode S Transponders).
Familiarity with all phases of the SE design process: ConOps, requirements development, software / system Architecture, system Integration and test, and Verification and Validation.

Master’s degree in engineering or related field.

Strong communication and collaboration skills with research and engineering teams.
